title: 第7章 更换灵根第8章 上品火灵根
slug: 道爷斗法累了西幻炸个鱼怎么了
lines: 压迫感
巨大的压迫感
那常乐道人仅仅是释放先前收敛起来的气势，就将陈昭压的喘不过气来。
弑心蛊死了？何时？
难道是先前那筑基修士的天光斩？可那弑心蛊在体内，若是弑心蛊被斩，那自己岂不是一并被斩杀了？
“说，都发生了些什么”
面对常乐道人的逼问，陈昭自然是不敢透露秘境的存在，只说是让修士追击后跌入山洞，苏醒后修为增长，斩杀了两个同门的修士以后一路遁逃到这里。
陈昭说的那是情真意切，句句真心啊！
毕竟说出来的全都是真的，可没有半分谎言。
果不其然，气息的压制逐渐放松。
稍稍用神识搜索了一番陈昭的身体，确认陈昭没有撒谎，常乐道人便哈哈大笑起来。
“呵，那千虫老鬼还和我打包票说这蛊无人能解，原来也不过如此”
原来，陈昭最早是为修习蛊虫的魔修所掳掠，被植入弑心蛊后转手卖给了玄阴鬼府，恰巧当时炼制活尸的份额已够，便留下当了外派杂役，做做从天门宗偷窃信息的活计。
如今这蛊虫被破，常乐道人倒也不恼，重新摆出一副和蔼的表情。
“小子，那天门宗的手段我是一清二楚，他们可没有这能隔着你的皮肉骨劈开你体内蛊虫的本领，看你这毫不知情的样子，多半是某个我都要称一声前辈的大能修士随手为之吧。”
常乐道人这番说着，心中也松了口气，幸好自己足够谨慎，没有一上来就搜魂，若是那前辈大能有着一番恶趣味，在此人魂灵中安置了噬神术式，那恐怕自己的神识就要受到重创了。
玄清界有些大能，修为已达陆地神仙之境，但却恶趣味十足，就喜欢搞些稀奇古怪的禁制来恶心其他修士。
搜魂算是常见的魔修手段，有些大能便反向埋雷，在一些低境界的修士脑中埋入禁制，然后搞一些奇遇或大机缘于那些低阶修士身上，从而去吸引魔修。
直接将这修士打杀反而不会有什么问题，若是尝试去搜魂，那就正中靶心了。
常乐道人便见过一位同门长老，搜魂过程中碰触了大能设的禁制，整个脑袋炸裂，身陨了。
这便是利用了魔修的贪念。
“既然这样，我也不过多追问了，还是看看你任务完成的如何吧”
神识勾动棺材，捉出那棺材中的尸体，看见尸体腰间已经和焦黑的尸身粘连在一起的，隐隐写着【赵】字的令牌，常乐道人满意的点头。
果然自己的猜测是对的，天门宗的情况，常乐道人清楚的很，这赵炎其实是天门宗金丹老祖赵水的私生子，明面上被天门宗排挤，暗地里却为赵水所庇护，不然这赵炎早就和那赵火离一块被那外来的金丹修士烧死了。
这天门宗金丹老祖那么宠爱赵炎，自然是不会拿赵火离的尸身作为道具，供这小小炼气修士使用的，看来真是这小子偷偷掘出带走的，而不是什么天门宗的阴谋。
而且，自己若是天门宗，反而会主动保留那弑心蛊，不让人起疑心吧。
是大能出手赠与的机缘也好，虽直接夺得机缘会惹来杀身之祸，可在旁边蹭个光也无妨吧。
有些修习了观气之术修士，专门往气运浓厚的同道旁边凑，沾光也获得不少的好处。
想到此处，常乐道人决定暂且留这小修士一命看看。
“你且过来”
常乐道人招手将陈昭唤来，随即伸手戳进焦黑尸身之中，催动灵力，硬生生扯出灵根来。
未等陈昭看清这灵根长啥样，常乐道人便反手扎进了陈昭的肚子，将那赵火离的灵根塞了进来，随后从储物袋中翻出一本功法，丢给陈昭。
“本道言而有信，说给移植灵根就给移植灵根，区区上品火灵根而已，本道还看不上。
不过能不能成功还是要看你自己的造化，毕竟不是自身的灵根，你的身体会主动攻击这外来的灵根，所以需要修习功法调节。”
“这本功法专为融合灵根设计，你拿去修习，若是渡的过这融合的时期，我便收你为弟子，日后你可称为我师尊，你若是渡不够，便会当场爆体而亡。
知晓了就走吧。”
content_en:
sense of oppression
huge sense of oppression
Taoist Chang Le just released the previously restrained momentum and suppressed Chen Zhao until he could not breathe.
Is the mind-killing Gu dead? when?
Could it be the Sky Light Slash of the foundation-building monk from before? But the Heart-Killing Gu is in the body. If the Heart-Killing Gu is killed, wouldn't he also be killed?
"Tell me what happened."
Faced with the questioning from Taoist Chang Le, Chen Zhao naturally did not dare to reveal the existence of the secret realm. He only said that he let the monks chase him and fell into the cave. After waking up, his cultivation level increased. He killed two monks from the same sect and escaped all the way here.
What Chen Zhao said was true and sincere, every word of it was sincere!
After all, everything he said was true, and not a single lie.
Sure enough, the suppression of the breath gradually relaxed.
After briefly searching Chen Zhao's body with his spiritual consciousness and confirming that Chen Zhao was not lying, Taoist Chang Le burst out laughing.
"Oh, that old ghost Qianchong also assured me that no one can solve this poison. It turns out that it is nothing more than that."
It turned out that Chen Zhao was first kidnapped by a demon cultivator who practiced Gu. He was implanted with the Heart Killing Gu and then sold to the Xuanyin Ghost Mansion. It happened that the share of refining living corpses was enough at that time, so he was left as a foreign handyman to steal information from the Tianmen Sect.
Now that the poison has been broken, Taoist Chang Le is not annoyed and puts on a friendly expression again.
"Boy, I know very well what the sect did that day. They don't have the ability to split open the Gu worms in your body through your skin, flesh and bones. Judging from your uninformed appearance, it's probably some powerful monk who I want to call senior who did it casually."
As Taoist Chang Le said this, he felt relieved. Fortunately, he was cautious enough and did not search for the soul as soon as he came up. If the senior master had some evil intentions and placed the God-Eating Technique in this person's soul, then his consciousness would have been severely damaged.
There are some powerful people in the Xuanqing Realm whose cultivation has reached the realm of land gods, but they are very evil-minded and like to create weird restrictions to disgust other monks.
Soul searching is a common method of demonic cultivators. Some powerful people will bury mines in reverse, burying restrictions in the minds of low-level monks, and then create some adventures or great opportunities for those low-level monks to attract demonic cultivators.
There would be no problem if he killed the monk directly. If he tried to search for the soul, he would hit the target.
Taoist Chang Le once saw an elder from the same sect. During the soul search process, he touched the restriction set by the powerful, and his whole head exploded and his body died.
This is taking advantage of the greed of demon cultivators.
"In this case, I won't ask any more questions. Let's see how you completed your mission."
His spiritual consciousness moved the coffin, and he caught the corpse in the coffin. When he saw the token with the word "Zhao" written on the waist of the corpse that was already stuck to the charred corpse, Taoist Chang Le nodded with satisfaction.
Sure enough, his guess was correct. Taoist Chang Le knew the situation of Tianmen Sect very well. Zhao Yan was actually the illegitimate son of Zhao Shui, the ancestor of Tianmen Sect's Jindan. He was ostracized by Tianmen Sect on the surface, but secretly protected by Zhao Shui. Otherwise, Zhao Yan and Zhao Huoli would have been burned to death by the outside Jindan monk.
The Jindan Patriarch of the Tianmen Sect loved Zhao Yan so much, so naturally he would not use Zhao Huoli's corpse as a prop for this little Qi Refining monk to use. It seems that this boy secretly dug it up and took it away, rather than some Tianmen Sect conspiracy.
Moreover, if he were the Tianmen Sect, he would take the initiative to keep the Heart Killing Gu so as not to arouse suspicion.
It may be an opportunity given by a powerful being. Although taking the opportunity directly will lead to death, there is no harm in taking advantage of it.
Some monks who have practiced the art of observing qi specialize in gathering around fellow practitioners with strong qi, and gain a lot of benefits from taking advantage of them.
Thinking of this, Taoist Chang Le decided to spare the little monk's life for the time being.
"Come here"
Taoist Chang Le waved his hand to summon Chen Zhao, then reached out and poked into the charred corpse, activated his spiritual power, and forcibly pulled out the spiritual roots.
Before Chen Zhao could see what the spiritual root looked like, Taoist Chang Le pierced Chen Zhao's stomach with his backhand and stuffed Zhao Huoli's spiritual root in. He then took out a book of exercises from his storage bag and threw it to Chen Zhao.
"I keep my word. I will transplant spiritual roots when I say I will transplant them. They are just high-grade fire spiritual roots, but I still don't like them.
However, whether you can succeed or not still depends on your own good fortune. After all, it is not your own spiritual root. Your body will actively attack this foreign spiritual root, so you need to practice exercises to adjust it. "
"This technique is specially designed for the fusion of spiritual roots. If you can practice it, if you can survive the fusion period, I will accept you as a disciple. You can be called my master in the future. If you don't survive enough, your body will explode and die on the spot.
If you know it, leave. "
title_en: Chapter 7 Replacement of Spiritual Roots Chapter 8 High-Grade Fire Spiritual Roots
